caption: The drawing depicts a round wooden table with a pale, off-white finish showing signs of minor wear and aging. The table has a single door cabinet with a small knob on the right, which is shown partially open to reveal its hollow interior. Below the cabinet is a single drawer, also with a knob, that is slightly pulled out. The table stands on four straight legs reinforced by a curved, intersecting brace near the bottom. The composition is centered with the table rendered in naturalistic colors and subtle shadows, set against a plain background. A thin red line frames the drawing, and in the lower left corner, there is an inset technical sketch with dimensions annotated in red. The lower right corner contains a handwritten note with a date and signature in red ink.
title: Cellarette
